Subject: New vendor activation — OrionWare (marketplace / PO questions)

Hi Vanessa,

We were referred to Redwood by our platform team — OrionWare is preparing to list in the AWS and Azure marketplaces and need to complete your vendor onboarding so we can route POs and set up billing. A few items we need answers to before we can start the procurement loop: 

- What paperwork do you require to open a purchase lane (W-9, VAT/RFC alternatives for non-US)?
- Do you have a specific PO template we should use, or do you accept our standard PO?
- Who is the billing contact for Redwood invoices (AP email + remit instructions)?
- Are there additional security evidences you need before marketplace listing (SOC 2, encryption attestations)?

We have a tentative go-live for the Marketplace listings on 2026-08-18 and would like to understand how quickly we can get the PO acceptance and vendor account activated. Please include any links/portals we should use.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Samir Desai

Hi Samir — great to meet you over email. Welcome — we can get OrionWare into the vendor/PO lane for AWS & Azure marketplaces; below is the standard onboarding checklist and the quickest path to acceptance. I copied the folks who will own billing, legal intake, and marketplace listing.

Quick checklist (most common path):
1) Completed vendor packet: seller_onboarding_packet.pdf (attached)
2) Tax form: vendor_w9_form.pdf (US companies) — if you are non-US please provide your local tax ID and a VAT registration certificate / W-8BEN as applicable
3) PO acceptance: we prefer customers to use our merchant_po_template.docx, but we will accept a customer PO if the payment and remit terms match our standard net-30 and include Redwood's remit address.
4) Invoicing / remit: AP contact is ap@redwood.com. Remit: Redwood Inference, 125 Market St, SF, CA 94105. If you need e-invoice routing (Peppol/EDI) include that in the vendor packet.
5) Security evidence: a completed security_evidence_sheet.xlsx and (if requested) our SOC 2 summary. SOC 2 full reports are available under NDA — please flag if required for listing.

Attachments I included: seller_onboarding_packet.pdf, vendor_w9_form.pdf, merchant_po_template.docx, security_evidence_sheet.xlsx

Next steps / timeline:
- You return the completed packet + tax form + PO (or acceptance of our template) → we route to Billing and Legal (2–3 business days).
- Billing validates remit and issues vendor number (1–2 business days after legal sign-off).
- Marketplace listing typically requires coordinated evidence handoff with our Partner Ops team — allow 5–7 business days after vendor activation.

For your go-live on 2026-08-18, please aim to return the completed packet by 2026-08-06. If you need an expedited lane, we can prioritize with a one-time SLA exception (we'd need PO acknowledgement + signed DPA).

HubSpot deal: HS-34567 (I'll log all docs there). Drive packet link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b_onboarding_orionware

If it's easier, let's do a 20-minute call this week — happy to propose times.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Thanks Vanessa — that checklist is helpful. A couple of clarifying items before we start: 

- OrionWare is incorporated in the UK and will require VAT invoicing. Can Redwood issue invoices showing VAT breakdown and a UK remit address (we can accept USD if you prefer but need VAT fields present)?
- Our finance team wants to confirm the PO window: if we send our standard PO with 45-day payment terms, will Redwood accept it or do we need to use your merchant_po_template with net-30?
- For the SOC2, we only need the summary for now — what is the process to receive that under NDA?

We can return the packet by 2026-08-05, but the marketplace integration team asked whether Redwood can accept a provisional vendor activation (accept PO + basic vendor number) so we can start the AWS listing task while outstanding tax docs are updated. Is that an option?

If helpful, I can attach our standard PO and VAT certificate — let me know preferred format.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samir
